forecast.detailed_text: Southeast wind 5 to 10 knots becoming south 10 to 15 knots after midnight. Mostly cloudy through around midnight then becoming partly cloudy. Waves 1 to 2 feet.

upcoming.detailed_text: South wind 10 to 15 knots becoming 10 to 20 knots early in the afternoon, then becoming 15 to 20 knots late in the afternoon. Slight chance of showers and thunderstorms in the afternoon. Waves 3 to 4 feet.

South wind 15 to 20 knots easing to 10 to 15 knots with gusts to around 20 knots late in the evening, then veering southwest after midnight becoming southwest 10 to 15 knots with gusts to around 20 knots early in the morning. Chance of showers through around midnight. Chance of thunderstorms through the night. Showers likely after midnight. Waves 3 to 4 feet subsiding to 1 to 3 feet early in the morning.
Southwest wind 10 to 15 knots becoming west 15 to 20 knots in the afternoon. Chance of showers and thunderstorms in the morning. Waves 1 to 2 feet.
